	clear_array = global.ccp_country_page_items
	set_variable = { global.ccp_country_page_shown = global.ccp_country_page }

	add_to_variable = { global.ccp_country_pages_shown = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ccp_page_first = var:global.ccp_country_page }
	multiply_temp_variable = { ccp_page_first = 16 }
	set_temp_variable = { ccp_page_last = var:ccp_page_first }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ccp_page_last = 15 }
	for_loop_effect = {

			limit = {

CCP_country_apply = {
	var:global.ccp_player = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.ccp_pending_action = 1 }
			}
			annex_country = { target = var:global.ccp_pending_country }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.ccp_pending_action = 2 }
			}
			puppet = var:global.ccp_pending_country
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.ccp_pending_action = 3 }
			}
			declare_war_on = {
				target = var:global.ccp_pending_country
				type = annex_everything
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.ccp_pending_action = 4 }
			}
			white_peace = var:global.ccp_pending_country
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.ccp_pending_action = 5 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.ccp_panel_open = 0 }
			change_tag_from = var:global.ccp_pending_country
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 8 }
	set_variable = { global.ccp_modal_open = 0 }
	CCP_country_rebuild = yes
}
